bifrost: nothing found; no USD, scene-graph or RealityKit-style 3D layer in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/ui/src/
summary: USDKit authors and renders 3D Universal Scene Description stages through RealityKit. BifrOSt has no USD reader or writer, no 3D scene graph and no 3D rendering API for apps, and the framework depends on Apple's RealityKit stack, so there is no sensible BifrOSt counterpart.

features.note: Apple doc: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usdkit (Essentials). BifrOSt has no USD document model.
Apple doc: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usdkit (Transforms). Transforms in the SDK are 2D view transforms only.
Depends on RealityKit, an Apple-only rendering stack. Apple doc: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usdkit (RealityKit rendering and playback).
